title: com.enroll arguments: take a Project's responder slot for a capability (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: The responder is the authenticated session; a supplied process id, model name, origin, launcher label or descriptor never authorizes it. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments). Without the responder grant, a participant reply of the request's target Project answers a queued request only when its capability's slot is absent at generation 0 (no service ever held it): the result, the current state with its nearest date, or that it cannot be taken now and why, never only a word that it waits; with the slot active, stale, or absent at a later generation, a session that is not its holder sends no reply and leaves the request to that service. A session that enrolls answers each request it claims in the same turn by a com.progress note or a fenced reply carrying the state, and settles it with com.accept, then com.complete (DEC-0152 SA-2, SA-6).

capability.description: A capability of the caller's Project; the slot's Project comes from the endpoint, and the host's responder grant for it is checked in the same statement.
